EMPTY_FILE.title: Empty file
EMPTY_FILE.shows: The file contains no data (0 bytes).
EMPTY_FILE.does_not_prove: It does not show whether the file was emptied deliberately or created empty.

EXTENSION_MISMATCH.title: Extension does not match content
EXTENSION_MISMATCH.shows: The name ends in .%{extension} but the content starts with the signature of a %{detected} file.
EXTENSION_MISMATCH.does_not_prove: Renaming is common and often innocent; it does not by itself prove an attempt to hide content.

EXECUTABLE_CONTENT.title: Executable content under another name
EXECUTABLE_CONTENT.shows: The content is a %{detected} program although the name ends in .%{extension}.
EXECUTABLE_CONTENT.does_not_prove: It does not show that the program is malicious; analyse it in an isolated environment.

DUPLICATE.title: Duplicate content
DUPLICATE.does_not_prove: Identical hashes show identical content, not who copied the file or when.

UNREADABLE.title: File could not be read
UNREADABLE.does_not_prove: It does not show that the file is damaged; permissions or locks can cause this.

EVIDENCE_HASH_MISMATCH_WITH_CASE.title: Differs from the evidence registered in the case
EVIDENCE_HASH_MISMATCH_WITH_CASE.shows: The %{algorithm} of this file is %{actual}, but evidence %{evidence_id} was registered at intake with %{expected}: the file examined is not bit-identical to the registered item.
EVIDENCE_HASH_MISMATCH_WITH_CASE.does_not_prove: Who changed the file, when, or whether the change was deliberate; the analysis still ran so the examiner can decide.

EVIDENCE_NOT_IN_CASE_REGISTRY.title: Not registered in the case
EVIDENCE_NOT_IN_CASE_REGISTRY.shows: No item of case %{case_id} was registered with this path or this content, so its continuity from intake cannot be shown.
EVIDENCE_NOT_IN_CASE_REGISTRY.does_not_prove: That the file is altered or irrelevant; it may simply not have gone through intake.

REGISTRY_PATH_CONTENT_CHANGED.title: Registered path now holds different content
REGISTRY_PATH_CONTENT_CHANGED.shows: This path was registered earlier as %{previous_id} with other content; the current content gets a new evidence ID.
REGISTRY_PATH_CONTENT_CHANGED.does_not_prove: Which version is the original or why the content changed.

COLLECTED_RAW.title: Copied by raw NTFS read
COLLECTED_RAW.shows: The file %{source} was copied into the package as %{package} by reading the NTFS volume directly, so files Windows keeps locked could be read.
COLLECTED_RAW.does_not_prove: It does not show that the file is complete on disk: data still in the Windows cache and not yet written is not included.

COLLECTED_API.title: Copied with the normal file API
COLLECTED_API.shows: The file %{source} was copied into the package as %{package} through the normal Windows file interface.
COLLECTED_API.does_not_prove: It does not show that the copy includes data other programs had not yet written, nor the file's NTFS metadata ($FILE_NAME times).

NOT_COLLECTED_NO_ADMIN.title: Not collected: no administrator rights
NOT_COLLECTED_NO_ADMIN.shows: %{source} was not collected because the tool did not run as administrator: %{error}.
NOT_COLLECTED_NO_ADMIN.does_not_prove: It does not show that the artifact is missing or was hidden; run again elevated to collect it.

NOT_COLLECTED_LOCKED.title: Not collected: file locked
NOT_COLLECTED_LOCKED.shows: %{source} was not collected because it was locked and could not be read raw: %{error}.
NOT_COLLECTED_LOCKED.does_not_prove: It does not show that the file is missing or protected on purpose; Windows locks these files in normal use.

NOT_COLLECTED_ERROR.title: Not collected: read error
NOT_COLLECTED_ERROR.does_not_prove: It does not show that the artifact was tampered with; permissions, a full output drive or a damaged disk can cause this.

CHANGED_DURING_COPY.title: Changed while it was copied
CHANGED_DURING_COPY.shows: The source changed during the copy (%{fields}): size before %{size_before} bytes, %{bytes_read} bytes read. The package holds the bytes read at that moment.
CHANGED_DURING_COPY.does_not_prove: It does not show tampering: event logs and browser history are written to continuously on a running system.

PARTIAL_READ.title: Copied only in part
PARTIAL_READ.shows: Reading stopped with an error at byte %{offset} of %{size}: %{error}. The package keeps the bytes read before the error.
PARTIAL_READ.does_not_prove: It does not show that the rest of the file was deleted; a damaged sector or a file in use can cause it.

COPY_REREAD_MISMATCH.title: Packaged copy differs from what was read
COPY_REREAD_MISMATCH.shows: The packaged copy, read back, has %{algorithm} %{reread}, but the bytes read from the source had %{copied}.
COPY_REREAD_MISMATCH.does_not_prove: It does not show which side is wrong; the output drive may be faulty. Collect again to another drive.

VOLATILE_PARTIAL.title: Volatile data incomplete
VOLATILE_PARTIAL.does_not_prove: It does not show that those entries were hidden on purpose; protected processes refuse access even to administrators.

OUTPUT_ON_SYSTEM_VOLUME.title: Package written on the system volume
OUTPUT_ON_SYSTEM_VOLUME.shows: The package was written to %{out}, on the system volume %{volume} of the machine being collected, by explicit choice.
OUTPUT_ON_SYSTEM_VOLUME.does_not_prove: It does not show that evidence was overwritten, but writing there can overwrite deleted data; record why it was necessary.

NOT_AVAILABLE_FROM_SOURCE.title: Not available from this source
NOT_AVAILABLE_FROM_SOURCE.shows: Volatile data exists only on a running system; this run read a %{source} source.
NOT_AVAILABLE_FROM_SOURCE.does_not_prove: It does not show anything about the system that the image or folder came from.

CAPTURED_SNAPSHOT.title: Captured from the running system
CAPTURED_SNAPSHOT.shows: The tool wrote %{file} from what the running system reported (it is not a copy of a file on the volume).
CAPTURED_SNAPSHOT.does_not_prove: It does not show that the system reported everything: protected processes and kernel-level malware can hide entries.

limitations.SIGNATURE_TABLE_LIMITED: Type detection uses a limited table of common file signatures; unknown types are reported as unknown, not as suspicious.
limitations.TIMESTAMPS_FROM_FILESYSTEM: Modification times are those the source file system recorded ($STANDARD_INFORMATION), read at the time of the copy; they can be changed by software and are not proof of when content was written.
limitations.CLEAN_RESULT_IS_NOT_AUTHENTICITY: A result without findings does not prove that a file is authentic or unaltered before acquisition.
limitations.TIMESTAMP_PROVES_EXISTENCE_ONLY: A trusted timestamp proves the audit log existed in this exact form at the stated time; it does not prove that the examined copy matches the original source.
limitations.EXECUTION_LEAVES_TRACES: Running any program on the machine leaves traces of its own (prefetch, Amcache, the USB device entries in the registry): they are expected and must not be read as suspect activity.
limitations.RAW_READ_COMMITTED_STATE: A raw NTFS read sees what is written on disk at that moment; data still in the Windows cache, and files changing during the copy, may differ from what a later image shows.
limitations.NO_MEMORY_IMAGE: This version does not image RAM: the volatile lists are what Windows reported, which malware with kernel access can hide from.

custody.title_fr: Chain of custody sheet — digital evidence (France)
custody.basis_co: Prepared following Law 906 of 2004 (arts. 254–266), the chain-of-custody manual of the Attorney General's Office (Fiscalía) and Law 527 of 1999.
custody.basis_fr: Prepared for an expert examination under the French Code of Criminal Procedure (arts. 156 ff.); the seal number refers to the judicial seal (scellé).

ui.hash_tip_one: At least one algorithm is required.
ui.cancelling: Cancelling: finishing the current file, then writing partial reports…
ui.elevated_ok: Administrator: locked files are read directly from the NTFS volume
ui.elevated_no: Not running as administrator: system hives, event logs and other users' files will be listed as not collected
ui.restart_admin_tip: Opens the Windows administrator prompt, then this window closes. Settings chosen here are not carried over.

ui.source_path_hint: path of the image file or folder
ui.volatile_help: Processes, network connections, sessions and services of the running system.
ui.volatile_only_live: Volatile data exists only on the live system: not collected from an image or a folder.
ui.users_hint: optional: profile folder names, comma separated (empty = every user)
ui.out_hint: required: a removable or examiner drive
ui.allow_same_volume: Allow writing on the system volume
ui.allow_same_volume_warn: Writing the package on the system volume of the machine being collected can overwrite deleted data and alters the volume. Use it only when no other drive is available; the report records it.

ui.err_groups: Select at least one group to collect.
